children: Vice President Li Xiaoshuang revealed at the Auto Guangzhou 2026 that total deliveries of Xiaomi Auto's SkyNomad series exceeded 60,000 units as of yesterday (26th), with Guangdong Province currently being the province with the highest ownership of Xiaomi SkyNomad vehicles, Chinese news broke.
Moreover, users switching from or replacing fuel vehicles accounted for 50.3% of Xiaomi SkyNomad buyers, while family users accounted for 87.8%.
